name: Sale to sanctioned UBO via nominee
description: Vessel / aircraft acquired by an entity whose UBO is sanctioned (often an oligarch via SPV).

name: Flag-state shopping to obscure UBO
description: Vessel registered in jurisdiction with weak UBO transparency to obscure ownership.

name: Aircraft / dual-use component restriction
description: Aircraft or components subject to export-control regime; transfer breaches licence.

name: Charter / finance fraud
description: Charter customer or finance applicant submits fraudulent documentation.

name: Title / encumbrance fraud
description: Vessel sold with undisclosed mortgage / lien / disputed title.
